Claim :   Kunal Kamra said, \"The RDX laden car which caused the blast in Pulwama, RTO has not been able to access its papers stating under whose name it was registered, till date. The government wants more than 70 year old papers in the NRC.\"

Claimed By :  Twitter,
citations.context:
uths from Pulwama in connection to the attack, as Pakistani terrorist group Jaish-e-Mohammed claimed responsibility for the attack. However, after more than a year later, the official probe on this matter is yet to reveal any findings as to how the RDX reached the heavily militarized region of Kashmir.

BOOM searched with relevant captions on Facebook and Twitter, and found that it has been shared by several netizens since February 19, 2020. However, the text remained unattributed to anyone in all the posts.

> पुलवामा हमले में RDX से भरी जिस  
> कार ने बस पर धमाका किया था  
> RTO ने आज तक उसके कागज नही  
> ढूंड पायी कि कार किसके नाम पे थी  
> और सरकार को NRC में 70 साल पुराने  
> कागज चाहिए हद्द है ।
>
> — The Folks™ 📰 (@thefolksteam) February 21, 2020

> पुलवामा #RDX से भरी जिस कार ने बस पर धमाका किया था, #RTO आज तक उसके कागज नहीं ढूंढ पाया! कार किसके नाम पर थी,  
> सरकार को #NRC में 70 साल पहले के कागज चाहिए!#pulwama\_ke\_doshi\_kahan\_hai#NRC\_CAA\_Protest  
>   
> 💯👇@asadakur@Ak8055Good@drx\_hamid\_malik@DaudKhan3283@Sahibakhan05
>
> — ASADAKUR RAHMAN (@asadakur) February 19, 2020

BOOM performed relevant keyword searches to find past quotes by Kamra on the Pulwama attack. We could not find any comment by Kamra on the attack in any of his stand up comedy show or otherwise.
